title: Attraction-Ranking Mismatch in Out-of-Distribution Detection: Theory and Evidence from Hamiltonian Feature Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.06021v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Attracting features toward learned in-distribution (ID) regions is an intuitive strategy for out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, but does such attraction improve detection? We investigate this question using class-conditioned Hamiltonian dynamics as a controlled testbed and identify an attraction-ranking mismatch: improving individual class-affinity scores need not improve the relative ordering of ID and OOD samples. Our analysis separates misalignment between the driving field and the detection score from ranking failure that persists even when they are aligned. An exact AUROC decomposition and a local boundary analysis identify relative score changes at the ID-OOD ranking boundary as the source of first-order AUROC change under regularity conditions. Experiments demonstrate that a score-aligned rule can improve performance on a held-out source validation split yet consistently degrade it after transfer, even without a single winning-c

translated_title: 分布外检测中的吸引-排序失配：来自哈密顿特征动力学的理论与证据
translated_abstract: 将特征吸引至已学习的分布内（ID）区域是分布外（OOD）检测的一种直观策略，但这样的吸引是否真能改善检测效果？我们以类条件哈密顿动力学作为受控测试平台来研究这一问题，并识别出一种“吸引-排序失配”现象：提升单个类的亲和度分数并不必然改善ID样本与OOD样本之间的相对排序。我们的分析将驱动场与检测分数之间的失调，与即使两者对齐后依然存在的排序失败区分开来。通过精确的AUROC分解和局部边界分析，我们在正则性条件下确定了ID-OOD排序边界处的相对分数变化是一阶AUROC变化的来源。实验表明，一个分数对齐的规则可以在留出的源域验证集上提升性能，但在迁移后却会持续降低性能，即使没有一个获胜类……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文利用哈密顿特征动力学揭示了分布外检测中的“吸引-排序失配”现象：提升类亲和度分数并不必然改善ID与OOD样本的相对排序，且在源域验证集上有效的分数对齐规则在迁移后反而会损害检测性能。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies an "attraction-ranking mismatch" in OOD detection via class-conditioned Hamiltonian dynamics: improving class-affinity scores need not improve the relative ranking of ID and OOD samples, and score-aligned rules that help on source validation splits consistently degrade performance after transfer.
